_comment: ROLE 1 - infra. Operates the Langfuse deployment: compose, images, upgrades,
backups, env. This role legitimately needs docker and psql, so there is no
attempt to deny them - that would be theatre, and prefix-matched Bash rules
could not enforce it anyway (Bash(docker exec *) misses 'docker --context X exec').
SCOPE NOTE: until the override migrates out, role 1 spans TWO directories -
currently holds the live version pins, the ClickHouse digest pin and the v4
migration flags. That override is untracked and NOT gitignored, so 'git clean -fd'
in that directory destroys production config. Do not run it.
CROSS-ROLE CONTRACT: Langfuse excludes database schemas from semantic versioning.
langfuse_monitor_provision.py writes the monitors table directly, so a patch-level
server upgrade can break role 2's monitors silently. After ANY upgrade, run:
